title: Don't Assume They Meant It
coreMove: Acknowledge the impact as real before explaining what you meant.
sourcePressure: The chapter disentangles intent and impact, especially the deliverer-side failure of using good intent to dismiss harm.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Assuming good intentions are enough or treating hurt feelings as proof of malice.

sourceAnchors.name: intent vs impact
sourceAnchors.detail: The source separates what someone meant from what their action caused, and warns that intent explanations before impact acknowledgment usually worsen the exchange.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Good intent can sit beside real impact; it cannot erase it.
